chunks: And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said:
O son of Adam, remember Me for an hour after dawn and for an hour after the afternoon, and I shall suffice you regarding what concerns you.

key_terms.أَكْفِيكَ: I shall suffice you; Allah will take care of your needs.
key_terms.اذْكُرْنِي: Remember Me; engage in dhikr of Allah.
key_terms.الْعَصْرِ: The afternoon period, referring here to the time after the Asr prayer.
key_terms.الْغَدَاةِ: The early morning, referring here to the time after the dawn prayer.
key_terms.سَاعَةً: An hour; a designated period of time for remembrance.
key_terms.مَا أَهَمَّكَ: That which concerns you; the matters that preoccupy or trouble you.

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for remembering Allah after Fajr and Asr?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages sustained dhikr after the morning and afternoon prayers. It teaches that remembering Allah at these times brings divine sufficiency in one's important concerns.
